name: Singularity-RepoQL
description: Windows Singularity for a single Claude Code Full installation. The supported source profile includes Kanzo, Tencent MemoryCore integration, RepoQL, the native dashboard, Claude Office and Openmaus bots. This repository export is source-only; no native Windows runtime acceptance or production upgrade is implied.
license: MIT (see LICENSE); third-party components and licenses in THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md

claude_code.note: Claude Code hooks, agent definitions, settings, delegated memory profiles and documentation capture

kanzo.note: Kanzo connector and local claim layer; upstream Kanzo is separately installed

tencent_memorycore.note: MemoryCore connector and provenance-preserving derivative patch series; upstream engine separately installed

repoql.note: Externally installed and licensed RepoQL, pinned by the native connector contract

dashboard.note: Native Windows dashboard and local API, including Kanzo, memory and Agent Chat read models

claude_office.note: Claude Office integration and Windows bridge; third-party application requires separate verified binaries

openmaus_bots.note: Claude Code Openmaus maintenance and agent workflows

orchestration.note: Existing orchestrator authority and guarded Rust compatibility ports; no workflow authority migration approved

memory_ingestion.note: Current documentation ingestion, revision ledger and guarded Rust policy interfaces

kanzo.note: run as an unmodified separate process; the connector only reads its API

repoql_engine.note: the rql engine is never bundled; the user's own licence and terms apply

tencent_memorycore.note: Third party source and derivative patch provenance are tracked separately

claude_office.note: Windows frontend/backend require independent binary and runtime acceptance

checksum_authority.note: This tree was reconciled from the reviewed Wave56 source onto main. The current authority is the root SHA256SUMS plus the linked file-hash map. The native source manifest in the tree and the frozen Wave56 manifests are historical revision metadata with 37 known pre-existing mismatches; they do not verify this tree and must not be relabelled as acceptance.
